LakeSnes SNES emulator core, vendored unmodified from
https://github.com/angelo-wf/LakeSnes at commit 9db90b86e46a377609305e298dd92d71cd1d4c8a.
MIT licensed; see LICENSE.txt.

Local changes (marked "topgear-pc" in the source):
- cpu.h/cpu.c: optional traceHook called before each opcode fetch.
- snes.h/snes.c: optional readHook and writeHook called for every A-bus read and write.
